text: You sent your fucking price in the DM, right?
style: Cheeky and mocking, quick, like a best friend about to roast you.

text: He asked how much. Fifteen hundred, twelve weeks.
style: Proud and casual, a confident American guy bragging to his buddy, a short beat before the price.
Flat and deadpan, a trap question, he already knows the answer.

text: Left me on Seen since Tuesday. I'm dropping to nine ninety-nine.
style: Deflated on the first sentence, then stubborn and decided, like it's a genius plan.

text: Smart. Now he ghosts you at a discount.
style: A mocking roast, slow and smug, savoring the last word.

text: Relax, it's not your price. He doesn't know yet what it fixes.
style: Suddenly calm and serious, lower, like telling a friend the truth.
Confused and frustrated, voice going up at the end.

text: Saying no is awkward. Ghosting takes zero words.
style: Dry and matter-of-fact, a beat between the two sentences, the second one lands like a punchline.

text: I hate people wasting my damn time.
style: Annoyed and venting to a friend, a little loud, leaning on 'damn'.

text: Give the price, plus one question. What made you reach out today?
style: Confident and simple, like handing over a cheat code; the question said warmly, as if he were asking the lead.

text: I'm on calls all day. Who's asking that?
style: Tired and skeptical, a casual American guy, half laughing.

text: Me. Plug me into ManyChat. I answer the price from your offer, then ask the next question.
style: Smooth and smug, a sly little offer, a beat after 'Me.'

text: And when he goes quiet? Chasing comes off desperate.
style: Unsure and a bit embarrassed, quieter, a confession.

text: Maybe he just forgot. I nudge him up to three times in twenty-four hours.
style: Reassuring and easy-going, with a hint of smugness.

text: Okay. How do I get you?
style: Hesitant and a bit sheepish, a small pause after okay.

text: The lights are on a motion sensor, bro. You haven't moved since fucking Tuesday.
style: Mocking, laughing at him, slow and smug, savoring 'Tuesday'.

text: Comment SETTY and I'll send you everything to build your AI setter for free.
style: Smooth and smug, then warm and generous on the offer, like handing over a gift.
